name: 2CRSI SA
shortDescription: Entreprise de Strasbourg spécialisée dans la fabrication de serveurs informatiques.
detailedDescription: 2CRSi is a French global Tech group, listed on Euronext Growth Paris and active in the IT & Computer Hardware industry. The group develops, manufactures, and distributes end-to-end energy-efficient computing solutions, with a positioning around high-performance and high-efficiency server technology for data centers, AI, cloud and HPC. The content highlights tailor-made solutions, smart designs, operational agility and Green IT.
